derived.rows_at_kd_0_or_1: the overwhelming majority. Only six rows in the whole 176 exceed KD 20 (what phones are esim compatible 21, which phones are esim compatible 28, samsung phones that support esim 26, what phones have esim 32, what phones support esim 34, phones that support esim 18), and every one of those six is the generic list query rather than a named device.
derived.reading: a named device question is both the cheapest SERP to enter and the most valuable click. The generic 'what phones support esim' list query is the only part of this family that is contested, and it is also the least valuable per click. That is the inverse of the usual pattern and it is why this family is worth building first.

what_a_page_needs: a real capability fact per device: whether the model carries an eSIM, from which generation, how many profiles it stores, and whether the model sold in a given region differs (the Chinese mainland iPhone models are the known exception). Without that table the page is a guess, and a wrong answer on a KD 0 page with a 30.00 CPC is worse than no page.
